_about: Expected snapshots of golden_fulfillment_flow.script.json. First written by the Node reference (tools/golden-flow-node.mjs); every table except Stage_Events still equals Node. Since 2026-11-20 (plan step 7.0) the Stage_Events rows are the CORRECT ones, written by the Python port (one per stage entered), because the Node reference had a defect. Ids, timestamps, today and forecast fields are masked. Rewrite on purpose with REGENERATE_GOLDEN=1 (see tests/fulfillment/test_golden_flow.py). The QC and Crate saves in the script carry their mandatory evidence (photo, signature, checklist, crate weight and dimensions) since 2026-11-20 (app/fulfillment/mandatory.py).

fixed_defects: Stage_Events logged only the first stage of a package (Node reference and the first Python port): advance_stage, reconcile_fulfillment and the readiness-gate hook wrote Fulfillment_Stage through the raw store, which never fires the afterUpdate hook. Fixed 2026-11-20 in Python with app/fulfillment/stage.py set_stage().
